column1: Subgroup hazard ratios are descriptive. Differences between them are assessed ONLY by the interaction p-value, never by comparing which subgroup reached significance. With 112 events, power to detect effect modification is low, so a large interaction p-value does not establish that the effect is homogeneous. The male estimate rests on 20 events and male matching used no calendar-year constraint (protocol v2.0 change #6); it is exploratory.
